description: An npm workspace whose package names and member directories carry terminal escape sequences, a C1 control sequence introducer, a fake output line, a line separator, a backslash, and bidirectional formatting characters (U+202E, U+061C). Text output must escape every one of them and JSON output must spell them as escapes (SECURITY.md section 7.8, D-075, D-076). Hostile names and manifests naming the real next package are created at test time (Q-014).
